title: WORLD WAR THREE IS NOW
tags: the culture war with tim pool
description:
Iran mobilizes civilians to form human chains around key power plants as fears grow over imminent U.S. strikes on critical infrastructure. Trump escalates threats, warning that the country could face total destruction if demands are not met, pushing tensions to the brink of full-scale war. With civilians now physically surrounding potential targets, the conflict takes a dramatic turn as the risk of mass casualties and escalation intensifies.
